task-engine.host.description: Fixed loopback binding; localhost normalizes to 127.0.0.1.

task-engine.port.description: Engine TCP port; zero selects an available port.

task-engine.database.description: SQLite filename, relative to the source file directory.

task-engine.ipfsGatewayUrl.description: Legacy single Gateway alias. Root HTTP(S) URL only; cannot share a layer with ipfsGatewayUrls.

task-engine.ipfsGatewayUrls.description: Ordered trusted root HTTP(S) Gateways; whole-list replacement, no discovery. No credentials, query, fragment or path prefix.

task-engine.ipfsGatewayTimeoutMs.description: Total failover budget per missing block, including authorized hints; default 30000 ms.

task-engine.ipfsGatewayAttemptTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time per source, capped by remaining total budget; default 5000 ms.

task-engine.scope.description: Single local Caller scope. Other scopes are denied.

task-engine.ui.description: Start the HTTP-only local Web UI.

task-engine.uiOptions.description: Whole UI setting, replaced rather than deep merged. All properties required.
